ac.description: AC-powered chassis - normal-capacity AC supplies (high-line uses PEM0/PEM2; the four-bay low-line form is drawn).

base.description: Chassis only - what you spec before deciding what goes in it. The 4 slot bays are EMPTY; cooling, craft, psus are populated. Enough to power on and reach the box, which is the question most people ask first and the one `default` used to answer with whatever the drawing happened to be populated with.
base.source: derived - built from the group roles rather than from a vendor bundle: every bay whose group is `service` or `management` keeps its seat, every `traffic` bay takes a blank. This vendor publishes no base configuration for this chassis, so the library defines one. Where a vendor DOES publish one, follow it instead and say so here.

dc.description: DC-powered chassis as photographed - four normal-capacity DC PEMs, two SCB-MX with RE-S-1300, DPC 40xGE in slot 2 and DPC-R-4XGE in slot 1.

datasheet.title: HPE MX 204/240/480/960 Series Universal Routing Platforms data sheet (a00150825enw)

description: Juniper MX240 Universal Routing Platform - a 5RU, 3 Tbps-class modular edge router with horizontal cards. Four slots under the craft interface: DPC/MPC slots 2 and 1, the shared SCB1/DPC0 slot, and SCB0; the Routing Engines seat inside the SCBs. Up to four power supplies (AC or DC) across the rear top, with the fan tray and air filter installing vertically at the rear sides.

gaps.wanted: orthographic imagery for the current MPC/SCBE2-SCBE3/RE-S-X6 generation - the intake holds their figures and power tables but no straight-on photography, so the EOL FRUs the reference photograph carries are what is modelled. The power tables for the newer FRUs are already transcribed in the guide extraction for when they are built.
faces for the high-capacity AC/DC supplies (figures 15/17 are isometric line art only).

vendor dimensions for the craft panel and cards - no physical dimension for either exists in the intake. The craft face is sized to its photographed aperture; the cards' plate is photo-measured and their lever envelope read off the vendor's Visio stencil (#261), but the plate height is still estimated.
transceiver lists per DPC/MPC (external compatibility tool).

esd.description: the wrist-strap ESD points, front top-left (guide Figure 1 callout) and rear (the ESD procedure text: "one of the ESD points on the chassis")

grounding.description: the protective-earthing stud pair under the rear earth symbol (guide, chassis grounding points specifications)

scbs.description: dedicated Switch Control Board slots - they accept an SCB and nothing else, unlike the shared slots that take either an SCB or a DPC

slots.description: The card cage - DPC/MPC slots 2 and 1, the shared SCB1/DPC0 slot, and SCB0, numbered on the craft tabs and left flange. SCBs carry the Routing Engines in their own bays

name: mx240

card-slots.note: the MX240 front photograph (body px 2.5-1496.5 = 443 mm, 3.372 px/mm across; 743.5 px = 221.2 mm, 3.361 down): the card plates run x px 127.5-1463.5 = 396.2 mm, chassis x 37.07-433.3, the same edges on all four slots. Each slot is the 413.5 x 29.5 lever envelope of the card (#261), centred on the measured plate at x 28.5-442.0, with `opening` 396.0 x 29.5 - the plate, not the levers, because the levers stand proud of the face and read less reliably in a photograph (their tips read 0.9 mm further left than the centred plate puts them). The slot pitch is 31.0: the dark gaps between the plates sit 104.5-104.67 px apart (31.03-31.14 mm) in three column bands, centred at y 99.3/130.3/161.3/192.3. Until 3.0.0 the slots were 420.9 wide at x 11.5 on a 30.45 pitch, the aperture INCLUDING the slot-number tab strip, which is chassis.

chassis.note: datasheet-table - guide chassis description and Table 88: 8.71 x 17.45 x 24.5 in (221.2 x 443 x 622 mm) to the chassis rear (703 total with cable management), 23.6 kg bare / 58.1 kg maximum. Ears are NOT MODELLED by project convention

color.note: photo - dark charcoal chassis bands, grey craft panel with the light-blue accent strip, silver card faces (the 40xGE DPC is charcoal), bright aluminium rear

esd-front.note: guide Figure 1 callout - ESD point at the front top-left; placed at 8.0, 17.0 off the photograph, approximate (the socket is small and dark against the dark band)

front-rows.note: photo - top vent band 0-32.8, craft interface 32.8-75.3, card cage 84.55-207.05 as four 31.0 mm slots (top to bottom: DPC2, DPC1, SCB1/DPC0, SCB0 - the craft tabs and the slot-number tabs number them 2, 1, 1/0, 0), bottom band to 221.2. The slot-number tab strip runs x 10.5-35.4 and the card plates x 37.25-433.25 (card-slots, slot-tabs)

ground-stud-pitch.note: the hardware guide, chassis grounding points specifications: 0.625-in. (15.86-mm) centres, which is 5/8 in., 15.875; the guide rounds the conversion. The 13.2 read off the photograph is overruled. `ground-studs` is one placement of juniper/mx-ground-stud-pair-5-8@1, which composes juniper/mx-ground-stud@1 twice at exactly 15.875 (L116) and presents `stud-pair-5-8`, so one two-hole lug (generic/two-hole-lug-5-8@1) lands across the pair and the ring lug still lands on either stud, `ground-studs/1` and `/2`. The two studs were drawn 13.2 apart; they moved symmetrically about the midpoint the photograph placed, (426.7, 28.8), one stud above the other, so the host is placed at `rotate: 90` and a lug's wire leaves downward, and their cutouts with them.

ground-stud-size.note: the hardware guide, chassis grounding points specifications: two threaded inserts (PEM nuts) that fit UNC 1/4-20 screws, spaced at 0.625 in. (15.86 mm) centres, for one two-hole cable lug: the `stud-size` of both studs.

lifecycle.note: announced - the third-party EOL trackers (IT-Planet, Park Place) list MX240 EOL 2020-06-30 / EOS 2026-06-30 for the older base bundles while later revisions continued shipping; Juniper's per-SKU M/MX milestones page is authoritative and the milestones are per-SKU, searched 2026-08-27

other-faces.note: near-blank by evidence - the guide side art (Figure 1) shows the right side's round-hole exhaust field; sides carry an estimated vent-field band (right) and rail band (left), top and bottom rail edges only. Axis conventions per viewer3d.js: LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR, RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT, top/bottom y = 0 at the FRONT

populated-with.note: photo - the reference unit carries DPC 40xGE (DPCE-R-40GE- SFP) in slot 2, DPC-R-4XGE in slot 1, and SCB-MX with RE-S-1300 in both SCB slots; those exact FRUs are modelled and seated as the defaults, EOL though they are, because they are what the only orthographic photograph shows. Current-generation cards (MPCs, SCBE2/3, RE-S-X6) are in the intake's figures and power tables but have no orthographic imagery - see gaps

power.note: guide power tables - base system 40 W, cooling 70/85 W (normal/high capacity, from a dedicated PSU tap excluded from the output budget), SCB-MX 185 W at 55 C, DPCE-R-40GE-SFP 335 W, DPC-R-4XGE-XFP 310 W (Table 93; ambient unqualified for DPC rows). The guide gives no chassis total and instructs a per-configuration budget; the MX Series family datasheet does give one, typical power draw 1860 W AC and 1690 W DC, with no configuration, ambient or side named - carried as power-typical-w (AC) with the DC figure in power-typical-scope, envelope unstated. Table 94 is a worked sample (two MPC-3D-16XGE-SFPP, two SCBE2 with RE-S-1800, 1555 W output) and is not carried. Table 89's maximum thermal output (AC 7161 BTU/hour, 2100 W; DC 5074 BTU/hour, 1488 W) stays under thermal as a provisioning ceiling

rear.note: photo - four PEM bays across the top (x 11.0 on a 101.9 mm pitch, rows 8.9-88.6), PEM 0-3 legends on the plate below each bay, the protective-earthing studs at the top right (two, vertically at 426.7, y 22.2/35.4 - pitch read off the photo, approximate), the rear ESD socket at 356.4, 173.6, and the vertical air-filter (left) and fan-tray (right) door strips with their two-line legends on the plate. The large caution-text plate between them is not transcribed

scale.note: photo - BOTH DAM photographs pass the orthographic gate (front 0.1%, rear 0.7%) and are cropped exactly to the 443 x 221.2 body, so every position is a direct measurement at 3.386 px/mm. This is the first device in the set whose photos carry geometry on both axes; the guide figures were used for identification and vocabularies only

slot-tabs.note: the MX240 front photograph: a grey strip, x px 38-122 = chassis x 10.5-35.4, carries a white slot-number tab beside each slot (x 16.8-27.4, about 7.2 mm tall), the SCB0 tab blue and the shared SCB1/DPC0 tab half blue, half white. The slot numbers are printed on those tabs, at x 22.1; until 3.0.0 they were drawn at x 5.6 on the dark side rail.
